title: Athens Marathon: *both course records* fall
hook: Ethiopian winners rewrite the Athens record books on race day.

slides.label: What happened
slides.c: At the Athens Authentic Marathon on 8 Nov, the men's and women's course records both fell, per Greek media reports.

slides.label: The numbers
slides.c: Taferi (ETH) won the men's race, beating the 2:10:34 record from 2023. The women's winner (ETH) ran 2:30:04, beating 2:31:06 from 2010.

slides.label: Why it matters
slides.h: A *rare double* on the classic course
slides.c: The original marathon route is known for its hills. Both records falling on the same day is rare. Times are unofficial until confirmed by the organiser.

caption:
NEWS: Athens Marathon course records fall for men and women

At the Athens Authentic Marathon on 8 Nov 2026, Taferi (ETH) reportedly won the men's race in 2:10:03 and the women's winner ran 2:30:04, both new course records (as of 8 Nov, 14:00 CET).
Source: Greek City Times, FatMarathoner
